record.source: research/ring_floor_study/REPORT.md, the clocks cut (the ruled one)
record.product: MRMS PrecipRate crops in Marshall-Palmer proxy bands, 2026-09-17 to 2026-09-23; NOT the board's IEM N0Q rings
record.rerun: 2026-10-08 on live/rings_<date>.ndjson, the board's own rings
record.note: precision = the share of cycles with echo in the 6 mi ring at the band or above, with no tip in the prior hour (a today_in-only condition: not proof the gauge was reporting no rain), that were followed by a 0.01 in tip within 60 minutes; recall = the share of tips the band fired on. Cycles are 2 minutes apart, so n_fired overstates independent trials; the episode table is the board's unit and the event count is the honest n.

episodes.note: an episode is a contiguous run of fired 2-minute cycles at one station (12 min gap tolerance), the unit the board's arrival alert fires on; from REPORT.md's episode table on the clocks cut
